description: Deterministic pre-fetch URL & SSRF firewall detecting loopback, RFC1918, CGNAT, IPv6 mapped/unique-local/link-local, AWS/GCP/Azure/Alibaba metadata endpoints, hex/octal/decimal IP encodings, dangerous schemes, embedded credentials, punycode homoglyphs, and open redirects. Requires $0.002 (2000 atomic) Base USDC on eip155:8453 via @x402/mcp _meta["x402/payment"] or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

url.description: Single URL shorthand (up to 2048 chars) to inspect for SSRF, private/metadata IPs, dangerous schemes, credentials, IDN homoglyphs, and open redirects.

urls.description: URLs (up to 2048 chars each) to pre-screen before fetch for SSRF (loopback, RFC1918, CGNAT, IPv6 mapped/local, cloud metadata, hex/octal/decimal IP encodings), non-HTTP(S) schemes, credentials, punycode homoglyphs, and open redirects.

name: screen_url
